title: Need help with groceries while kids are home for summer break?
summary: Mid-North Food Pantry will open on Saturdays in June and July to provide additional support for students and their caretakers. The pantry is open Monday, Wednesday and Friday year round.

title: Residents push back on a $2 billion data center proposal on Indy’s east side
summary: David Armistead, senior vice president of sales for DC Blox, speaks to residents at a Warren Township community meeting Thursday, May 21, 2026 about the company’s proposed $2 billion data center campus on Indianapolis’s east side.

title: East 10th Street’s future: Where ‘people have a good time’
summary: We were at a town hall May 21 to talk about what we’d like to see as part of a big project to turn our stretch of East 10th Street into a cultural district. People came from the surrounding neighborhoods: Little Flower, Emerson Heights and Grace Tuxedo Park.

title: Watch a free movie outside in Lawrence this summer
summary: In partnership with Heartland Film, the city will host two free movie nights at the Fort Ben Cultural Campus, 8950 Otis Ave .

title: Low-income apartment building approved for Stringtown
summary: A vacant home in Stringtown on the west side of Indianapolis is seen May 21, 2026. A developer plans to build an apartment complex on the site.

title: Indianapolis church buys Martin University property, plans for community center and affordable housing
summary: Eastern Star Church closed on a deal to acquire the real estate portfolio of Martin University, which closed abruptly earlier this year.

title: Indianapolis takes a step toward food justice — one micro-grant at a time
summary: A new initiative aimed at strengthening Indianapolis’ local food system is investing directly in the farmers, growers and food retailers already working to feed neighborhoods across the city.
